body.segment: In a film stack of bathocuproine (BCP) (electron transport layer), fac -tris(2-phenylpyridyl)iridium(III) [Ir(ppy)3] blended in 4,4'-bis(N -carbazolyl)biphenyl (CBP) (light-emitting layer), and 4,4',4?-tris(N -carbazolyl)triphenylamine (TCTA) (hole transport layer), the BCP and Ir(ppy)3:CBP layers rapidly interdiffuse by anomalous Fickian diffusion.
Diffusion leads to a decrease of up to 33% in the solid-state emission but no change in color.
